messages:
alex: getting a few 5xx alerts from the canary pool in eu-west-1. seeing probe failures + a small uptick in p95 for inference requests. not yet widespread but trending up. :rotating_light:
oncall-bot: ALERT: service=infer-worker env=prod region=eu-west-1 metric=5xx_rate threshold=1.5% current=3.8% - paging @eng-oncall
maria: which rollout? is this the fastpath experiment we flipped this morning?
alex: yes, partial rollout (10%) of image v3.2 + feature flag fastpath=true. only in eu-west-1 canary nodes.
sam: on it. first glance at readiness probes show a lot of connection resets. curl to health endpoint returning 502 occasionally.
sam: running quick check: `for p in $(kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=infer-worker -o name); do kubectl -n prod exec $p -- curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:8080/health || echo "pod $p fail"; done`

(snip)

sam: sample output:
```
200
502
200
502
```

lia: logs look like this from one canary pod:
```
2026-07-28T12:14:02Z ERROR rpc: read tcp 10.4.3.12:44722->10.2.1.45:8080: read: connection reset by peer
2026-07-28T12:14:03Z WARN cache: kv cache miss, backend latency=1200ms
2026-07-28T12:14:04Z ERROR inference: model load timeout 5s
```

maria: hmm kv cache latency spike + model load timeout. could be memory pressure from the new fastpath codepath. any OOMs?
sam: no OOMs in the canary logs. but I see a repeated stacktrace from the fastpath handler that wasn't there before.

alex: initial impact: canary 10% traffic in eu-west-1 only. customer-facing impact minimal so far but if it ramps we hit client retries and tail latency. recommend aborting rollout and flipping kill-switch.

lia: agree. set kill-switch in LaunchDarkly or env flag to false. i can flip if someone posts the safe rollback steps.

sam: steps to abort:
1) flip feature flag fastpath=false in LaunchDarkly (project: redwood-infer, env: prod) or use admin CLI:
```
ld toggle --env prod --flag fastpath --off --comment "Abort canary due to 5xx spike - eu-west-1"
```
2) pause the rollout in deployment controller: `kubectl -n prod rollout pause deployment/infer-worker`
3) revert image to v3.1: `kubectl -n prod set image deployment/infer-worker infer-worker=registry/redwood/infer-worker:v3.1`
4) monitor health and p95 for 10m, then resume safe rollout once stable.

alex: i'm going to open an incident ticket and post to status page. lia, can you flip the flag? i'll kick off the rollback if you do.

lia: flipping flag now.

opsbot: ACTION: LaunchDarkly flag fastpath set to OFF by lia (comment: Abort canary due to 5xx spike).

maria: updating incident ticket INC-2026-298 with current impact and mitigation plan. tagging SRE and runtime teams.

sam: pausing rollout controller now. `kubectl -n prod rollout pause deployment/infer-worker` - done.

sam: reverting to v3.1 image now. `kubectl -n prod set image deployment/infer-worker infer-worker=registry/redwood/infer-worker:v3.1` - initiated.

alex: status-page update drafted: "Investigating increased error rates for inference requests in eu-west-1 canary. Traffic is being directed to stable capacity while we roll back the canary. No widespread impact currently." want to publish?

maria: publish it and add note that customers on eu-west-1 may see intermittent errors.

status-page-bot: Posted update to status.redwood.com: "Investigating increased error rates in eu-west-1 canary. Mitigation in progress."

lia: rollback completed on deployment controller, pods are back to image v3.1 and initial health checks passing.
sam: can confirm health endpoints now returning 200 consistently. p95 back to normal for the past 3 minutes.
alex: good. i'm going to mark the canary rollout aborted and record root-cause follow-up with runtime/ML to look at fastpath memory behavior.

maria: assigned follow-up to @runtime-team and @ml-infra with logs and repro steps. also adding note to runbook: increase KV cache timeouts during canary for fastpath experiments.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: INC-2026-298 | state=mitigated | summary=Canary rollout of fastpath caused probe failures in eu-west-1; rollback to v3.1 completed; monitoring.

alex: handing off to lia for next 2 hours for post-mortem and monitoring. lia, you good to take it?

lia: taking it. will keep watch and start a postmortem doc. ping me if anything regresses.

sam: leaving now, available on pager if it flares back up.

maria: wrote initial blameless postmortem outline in /docs/incidents/INC-2026-298.md and linked metrics + logs.

alex: summary for execs: aborted canary within ~12 minutes of first alert, no customer-wide outage, rollback completed, follow-up actions created (runtime/ML root-cause, runbook updates, stricter canary thresholds).

lia: confirming monitoring will alert if p95 > 200ms or 5xx_rate > 1% in any region.

opsbot: Reminder: run postmortem meeting within 48h. Assigned: alex(mgmt), lia(oncall), sam(eng), maria(ops).

status-page-bot: Posted update: "Mitigation complete, services stable in eu-west-1. Investigating root cause."
